story.title: Norway Holds Funeral for King Harald V with Thousands in Attendance
story.summary: Norway held a funeral for King Harald V, attended by thousands of mourners in Oslo. European royals and world leaders gathered to pay their respects to the long-serving monarch, marking a significant moment in the nation's history.

timeline_highlights.title: Norway Mourns King Harald V as Crown Prince Haakon Ascends to the Throne
timeline_highlights.summary: Norway is in mourning following the death of King Harald V at the age of 89. Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre, along with officials and citizens, gathered to pay tribute outside the Royal Palace in Oslo. Crown Prince Haakon is set to become the new king.

timeline_highlights.title: Norwegian King Harald V Passes Away; Haakon VIII Becomes Monarch
timeline_highlights.summary: King Harald V of Norway has died at the age of 89 after serving as monarch for 35 years. His son, Haakon, has been proclaimed King Haakon VIII, marking the beginning of a new era for the Norwegian monarchy. King Harald was known for his reformist approach and commitment to inclusivity.
key_facts: King Harald V died at age 89.
He ruled for 35 years.
Haakon VIII is the new king.

timeline_highlights.title: Norway's New King Haakon VIII Honors Late Father in First Address
timeline_highlights.summary: In his inaugural speech as King Haakon VIII, the new monarch paid an emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V. Haakon expressed his commitment to uphold Norway's democracy and inclusive values while outlining his vision for the monarchy's future.
key_facts: Haakon VIII became king following the death of Harald V.
The new king emphasized his dedication to democracy and unity in his speech.

related_stories.title: Dispute Erupts Over Succession in Ugandan Kingdom Following Late King's Will
related_stories.summary: A succession dispute has arisen in the Tooro kingdom of Uganda after the family of the late King Oyo rejected the appointment of a popular TV news anchor as his successor. The family claims that King Oyo left a will designating his young son as the rightful heir, leading to tensions over the future leadership of the kingdom.

related_stories.title: Kimmel Moves Talarico Interview to YouTube Amid FCC Threats
related_stories.summary: Jimmy Kimmel announced that his interview with Texas Senate candidate James Talarico will not air on television due to alleged threats from the FCC against his show and the ABC network. Instead, the interview will be available on YouTube. Kimmel described the situation as 'unusual circumstances' surrounding the interview.

related_stories.title: Nvidia Tops 2026 World's Best Companies List Amid AI Boom
related_stories.summary: Nvidia has been ranked as the top company in the 2026 World's Best Companies list, which evaluates firms based on employee satisfaction, revenue growth, and sustainability transparency. The ranking reflects the ongoing boom in the AI economy, despite ongoing discussions about the technology's regulation and implementation challenges. Meanwhile, Google has announced a significant investment in AI and energy infrastructure in Finland, aiming to expand its data centers and secure nuclear energy, which the government claims will create jobs.
